Karnataka CM launches nationwide polio vaccination drive for children under 5

The Karnataka Chief Minister has announced a nationwide polio vaccination drive targeting all children under the age of 5. The initiative aims to immunize millions of young children across the country against polio, a highly infectious and potentially life-threatening disease. This move is part of efforts to boost public health and prevent the spread of diseases. The campaign's success will depend on effective implementation and participation from parents and healthcare providers.
